'''Doornik-1142''', a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Brown dwarf/Legends|dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]], was the primary star of the [[Doornik-1142 system/Legends|Doornik-1142 system]], located at the edge of the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]]. It was orbited by four gaseous [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

During a survey of the system, the ''[[Astrolabe]]'' was destroyed by the [[Yevetha]], who had moved their entire [[Black Eleven Fleet]] to the system.
